svg.aria-label: Wea app showing a team of bots: Inbox triage drafts three replies and asks before sending, then hands a scheduling task to Calendar keeper
svg.title: Wea app showing a team of bots: Inbox triage drafts three replies and asks before sending, then hands a scheduling task to Calendar keeper
svg.text: Good morning. Three client emails came in overnight.
I drafted replies in your usual tone. Want me to send them?
Send them. Then move my call with client A to Thursday.
Sent. I asked Calendar keeper to find a Thursday slot.
Thursday 10:00 AM works. Waiting for your yes.
